interpretation.intervals: prespecified paired 95% t, df=4 for five scorer seeds; pointwise and unadjusted

interpretation.timing: concurrent local CPU workers; traced seed13 wall time includes serialization; no isolated-throughput inference
interpretation.occupancy: sum of held intervals c_i-a_i, divided by last-final minus first-arrival horizon; includes exact deadline drain; peak is recorded by engine
